liquid-glass-note-surface.summary: Explore adopting the system's Liquid Glass for the note surface on macOS versions that have it, with the drawn frosted stack as the fallback below — the two-rendering fork the launch decision closed.

grid-drag-preset-editor.summary: Define a preset's geometry by dragging a box on a screen grid, Moom-style, instead of typing dimensions and flipping units — including whether the grid's coarseness is user-configurable.

in-place-preset-creation.summary: Create a preset from a fumi complete in one step, including its per-dimension pt/% units, without a visit to the Presets pane
